M1-a-twelfth-member-signed.what: the receipt payload carries issued_at beside the eleven members, and the signature covers it: the packet verifier names the member and verifies (the text does not say a receipt carries nothing else); the letter check fails

M2-a-member-missing-signed.what: the receipt payload has ten members: rail_anchors_hash is absent, and the signature covers the ten

M3-manifest-names-01.what: the same packet under a manifest whose profile member names draft-xg-payment-dispute-profile-01: nothing the packet verifier re-derives depends on that member

M4-statement-signed-with-another-key.what: the Signed Statement carries the receipt's canonical bytes and the receipt's key_id as kid, and is signed with another key

M5-subject-is-not-the-action-identifier.what: the Signed Statement's subject names another action than the packet manifest's action_id

M6-statement-carries-the-whole-packet.what: the Signed Statement's payload is the file of the whole dispute packet, the form of the parent case's registration, not the receipt's canonical bytes

M7-statement-carries-the-receipt-not-can.what: the Signed Statement's payload is the receipt as indented JSON: the same receipt, not its canonical bytes

M8-statement-carries-another-receipt.what: the Signed Statement's payload is the canonical bytes of the parent packet's receipt (the same action, another receipt), signed with this packet's receipt key

M9-statement-carries-the-payload-member-.what: the Signed Statement's payload is the canonical bytes of the receipt's payload member, without the signature object: the other reading of "the receipt's canonical bytes" (letter.READINGS, R1). It fails here because one reading was chosen, not because the text excludes it

M10-statement-without-issuer.what: the CWT claims of the Signed Statement carry a subject and no issuer

M11-approval-held-outside-the-ledger.what: the ApprovalGranted event keeps the parent case's dps_approval, the typed digests of an approval held outside the ledger (Section 5: out of scope for this revision); the ledger is chained over it and the packet verifier, which reads that member as an extension, names no failure

M12-a-number-in-the-receipt.what: mandate_hash is the number 0 in the receipt and in the agent anchors, signed: outside the value domain Section 4 states for the receipt (strings, booleans, null). The packet verifier canonicalises integers below 2^53 (its own allowance, for the recorded intent scope) and names no failure

M13-receipt-and-statement-signed-end-to-.what: the receipt and the Signed Statement are signed with another key, and the manifest and signer_pubkey_hash declare that key: the packet is consistent with itself (the letter check, which reads only the packet, passes) and fails against the key resolved out of band (Section 11: "without a key resolved out of band, a packet re-signed end to end with another key verifies")

M14-statement-under-an-algorithm-that-is.what: the Signed Statement's protected header names alg -7 (ES256) over an Ed25519 signature
